name: Kiriyama Kaori
source:
Nee-San Who Wants to be an idiot

Yuichi's childhood friend and a year older nee-san.
She has an image of being a strong woman because of her sisterly behavior, but in fact she is quite a clumsy girl. She is always blabbing about various things without people's knowledge.
She moved far away from Yuuichi for family reasons, but she wanted to be with him so much that she transferred to the same school.
Despite this, she is tense in front of Yuuichi and is unable to express her feelings well.
As a result, she is upset when Yuichi looks at her with a bad attitude, which is contrary to her feelings.

[From Pikopiko's official website]
